pr_title: Fix BackButton handling input before all other UI elements
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/5177

Attempt 2, now with 100% more automated testing.

This approach just rebuilds the `KeyBindingInputQueue` with the back button at the end.
pr_comments:
On discussion with @peppy, it might be cleaner to do this via the action receptor model.

```yaml
Children:
    backButtonReceptor
    screenStack
    backButton(backButtonReceptor)

class BackButton:
    ctor(BackButtonReceptor receptor = null):
        receptor.OnPressed += ...
        receptor.OnReleased += ...
```
Exiting from overlays is not tested.

issue_context.title: SearchTextBox no longer clears text when pressing Escape
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** The expected behaviour, when pressing `Esc`, is that the `SearchTextBox` on the carousel clears the text it contains. After that, the next `Esc` key pressed should return to the Menu.

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** https://streamable.com/116sk

**osu!lazer version:** 2019.628.0

review_comments: This is required because this actually takes quite a long time in headless, and trying to toggle the options overlay off while its not loaded with escape will not work since the `FocusedTextBox` has not taken focus yet.
